baseline_compatibility_patch: The original baseline and first candidate both failed on the development Thorns case: uncomputed_reactions.affected_outputs accepted strings but rejected lossless text_ref encoding. For the final comparison, both schemas accept the same text type. No baseline facts, prompts, candidates or policy are changed. Original failed replays are retained.
holdout_selection: For each held-out run, use the first actionable snapshot of player turns 1 and 3 in its final encounter. Select snapshots by metadata, without looking at model choices. Freeze candidate source before opening holdout results.
comparison: Replay the identical observed state and confirmed pre-cutoff memory with baseline and candidate, using the same Jev model. Two repetitions per held-out case. No game commands, no later draws, no outcome inserted into model state. Preserve all results, including regressions and unchanged decisions.
assessment: Check legal sequence, trigger consumers before expiry, current loss conditions, resource timing and reaction exposure. Report mechanism-specific improvements and tradeoffs, not a fabricated full-plan optimality score or win rate.
limitations: These runs predate this split and some failures informed earlier versions. This is a prospective holdout for this change, not an untouched benchmark. A different decision is not automatically a better one. Replays do not execute unknown draws or establish victory.
